nodescopes.description: An npm scope. A scope is the namespace granted to an npm user account or organization, and it is what allows two publishers to use the same package name without conflict. The reserved scope '_' holds the unscoped, flat global namespace, in which a bare package name is unique across all publishers.

scope.description: The npm scope this Group represents, without the leading '@', e.g. 'babel'. For the reserved unscoped Group this attribute MUST be absent, since unscoped packages belong to no scope.

sourceurl.description: Base URL of the npm registry from which this scope was projected, e.g. 'https://registry.npmjs.org'. This records provenance only; npm metadata documents are registry-agnostic and a package name denotes the same package whichever registry serves it.

packages.description: A Node.js package in the registry, including its metadata and available versions.

name.description: The canonical npm package name, verbatim and unaltered, including the leading '@scope/' for scoped packages. This is the authoritative name of the package; the packageid is only an addressing key and omits the scope, which is promoted to the Group.

license.description: The license under which the package is distributed.

author.description: The author of the package. npm normalizes the upstream 'author' field, whether written as a string or as an object, into a person object.

url.description: A URL identifying the person, such as a home page or profile.

dist.description: The distribution record for this version: where the published tarball can be fetched and how its integrity can be verified. npm guarantees this object is present on every published version.

tarball.description: URL of the published tarball for this version.

shasum.description: Lowercase hex SHA-1 digest of the tarball, as published by the registry.

integrity.description: Subresource Integrity string for the tarball, e.g. 'sha512-...'. Present for versions published by npm 5 and later.

file_count.description: Number of files contained in the tarball. Projects npm 'fileCount'.

unpacked_size.description: Total size in bytes of the tarball contents once unpacked. Projects npm 'unpackedSize'.

npm-signature.description: Detached PGP signature over the package name, version and integrity value, as issued by the registry.

homepage.description: The main homepage URL for the package.

repository.description: The repository information for the package.

dependencies.description: The dependencies required by the package.

name.description: The name of the dependency package.

version.description: The version specifier for the dependency (e.g., ^1.0.0, ~2.1.0).

package.description: Cross-reference to the dependency package in the registry.

name.description: The person's name, which for a maintainer is their npm account name.

url.description: A URL identifying the person, such as a home page or profile.

maintainers.description: A list of maintainers for the package.

dist-tags.description: Distribution tags for the package (latest, next, etc).

bugs.description: Bug tracking information for the package.

url.description: A URL identifying the person, such as a home page or profile.

contributors.description: List of contributors to the package.

os.description: Operating systems on which this version is installable, using npm's process.platform values, e.g. 'linux' or 'darwin'. An entry prefixed with '!' excludes that platform.

cpu.description: CPU architectures on which this version is installable, using npm's process.arch values, e.g. 'x64' or 'arm64'. An entry prefixed with '!' excludes that architecture.

deprecated_message.description: The npm 'deprecated' notice. Its presence indicates the package or version is deprecated; the core 'deprecated' object attribute MUST also be set when this attribute is present.

dev_dependencies.description: Development dependencies for the package. Projects npm 'devDependencies'.

name.description: The name of the development dependency package.

version.description: The version specifier for the development dependency (e.g., ^1.0.0, ~2.1.0).

package.description: Cross-reference to the development dependency package in the registry.

peer_dependencies.description: Peer dependencies for the package. Projects npm 'peerDependencies'.

name.description: The name of the peer dependency package.

version.description: The version specifier for the peer dependency (e.g., ^1.0.0, ~2.1.0).

package.description: Cross-reference to the peer dependency package in the registry.

optional_dependencies.description: Optional dependencies for the package: dependencies whose installation failure does not fail the install. Projects npm 'optionalDependencies'.

name.description: The name of the optional dependency package.

version.description: The version specifier for the optional dependency (e.g., ^1.0.0, ~2.1.0).

package.description: Cross-reference to the optional dependency package in the registry.

bundle_dependencies.description: Dependencies that are bundled inside this version's published tarball. Projects npm 'bundleDependencies'. The upstream field is a list of names only, so no version range is carried.

name.description: The name of the bundled dependency package.

package.description: Cross-reference to the bundled dependency package in the registry.

replacedby.description: Cross-reference to the package that supersedes this one, when the registry or publisher has identified a replacement.
